prompt: This min-heap starts empty and is stored in an array. We push 5, 3, 8 and 1, then pop once. Each push sifts up while the parent is bigger.

explain: Pushing 1 puts it at index 3; its parent (index 1, value 5) is bigger so they swap, then its new parent (index 0, value 3) is bigger so they swap again, leaving `1 3 8 5`. A pop returns 1, moves the last value (5) to the root and sifts it down by swapping with its smaller child 3: `3 5 8`.
